text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, striving to forge a consensus on a government line-up, meets Islamist-oriented Movement of a Peaceful Society (MPS) leader Mahfoud Nahnah on Saturday.
- A bomb explosion kills one in a market at El Afroun town, south of Algiers, one day after a bomb blast in Algiers on Thursday killing two people and wounding about 20.
- MPS, former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) and National Democratic Rally (RND), grouping President Liamine Zeroual's backers, to form a coalition government.
- Security forces kill two "terrorists" in Algiers.
- Newly elected National Assembly (lower house) resumes session on Saturday to elect parliamentary commissions.
- The government line-up will be announced this week.
- Opposition parties want changes on election law ahead of the local election this year.
